Maria: Quick onboarding heads-up — I've sent the master calendar invites for next Monday's welcome block. All sessions are in one recurring invite (main 3h block + 1h breakout tracks). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/1234567890 (pass: redwood). Recording will be enabled and uploaded to Drive within 24h.

Ken: Thanks! Will recordings be in the company Drive folder or inside the onboarding space?

Maria: Drive — /Shared/onboarding/new-hires/Apr2025. I'll post the link after the first session. Also FYI: calendar events were created in Pacific Time by default; APAC/EU folks, please double-check your local times.

Liam: My calendar shows the event at 1am local time (I'm in IST). Any tips?

Maria: Two quick fixes: 1) In Google Calendar, open the event > More actions > Duplicate and set the timezone under date/time to your local TZ, then save (creates a personal copy). 2) Or update your Google Calendar primary timezone: Settings > Time zone. For Apple Calendar, import the .ics and ensure the `DTSTART` line has the correct TZID. Example snippet: `DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Kolkata:20250406T093000`.

Anna: Will there be a recording-only link for people in other timezones? I can't make the 9am PT live.

Maria: Yes — we'll upload the full recording, plus a condensed 30-min recap with key slides for asynchronous folks. Written notes + slides will also be in the Drive folder.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Please fill out the New Hire Pre-Flight form: https://redwood.ai/preflight (due 48h before your first day).

Ken: One more—are breakout tracks recorded or just the main block?

Maria: Breakouts are partially recorded. Platform & Security tracks will be recorded; small team intro 1:1s will not. We'll mark which recordings are available in the Drive index.

Liam: Thanks — also can someone add the event to Outlook? I keep getting duplicate timezone conversions when importing .ics.

Anna: If you see duplicates, import the .ics, then decline/delete the duplicate event that shows the wrong TZ. Import the one that matches your local time.

Maria: I'll post the Drive folder link and the recording + captions right after the session. If anyone still has timezone grief, ping me or DM @ken. :slightly_smiling_face:
